lines.text: A chaotic swarm of federal agents floods the grand courtyard as red and blue police lights strobe against the limestone pillars.
Twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse Harper collapses onto the marble floor, blood rapidly pooling from her chest where Jake shot her.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper! Stay with me, please, look at my eyes!
Thirty-two-year-old CEO Cole lunges forward with his hands still cuffed, screaming in raw agony as federal agents rush past him.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: No! Mom, what did you make me do? I didn't mean to shoot her!
Twenty-nine-year-old sales head Jake drops his smoking gun, staring in sheer horror at his hands while his mother Diane grabs his arm.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Shut up, Jake! She was going to put us both behind bars for poisoning Evelyn!
Fifty-eight-board member Diane tries to drag her crying son toward the back exit while federal agents draw their weapons on them.
Cole drops to his knees beside his bleeding wife, pressing his bound hands against her chest to stem the terrifying flow of blood.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Cole... your hands... you're really the CEO...

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: I'm just your husband, Harper. Don't close your eyes, stay with me!
Harper's eyelids flutter and close completely as her head falls back against the cold marble floor.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Medic! Get over here right now, she's dying!
Cole screams with unbridled fury as federal agents finally tackle Diane and a sobbing Jake to the ground.

lines.speaker: DETECTIVE
lines.text: He's gone, Mr. Whitmore. There's no pulse.
Cole stares down at his lifeless wife in utter devastation, his hidden empire turning to dust in his arms.
